summary: Ordinary words that the vendored LDNOOBW lists, the graded overlay or the bad-words backstop would otherwise flag. Allow lists apply across all seven languages, because every language's list runs against every submission. Lookup runs on the literal case-folded token, before diacritic, confusable and leet folding, so an accented, stretched or disguised spelling of a flagged word still screens.
rules: Every entry names the language it is ordinary in and why it is here. An entry that clears an upstream term outright says what it costs. Remove an entry rather than leave one whose reason no longer holds.
